name: com.realcryptocap/realcryptocap
title: RealCryptoCap
description: Live crypto prices (HTX primary), real market cap rankings, AI market brief, news and Pro data.

tools.name: get_crypto_prices
tools.description: Live price, real-market-cap rank, market cap, 24h change, 24h high/low and volume for up to 20 cryptocurrencies. Accepts tickers (BTC), names (Solana) or ids (bitcoin). Use it for "what is X at", "how is X doing" and comparisons between coins.

tools.name: get_top_cryptos
tools.description: Ranking of native cryptocurrencies by real market cap (stablecoins, wrapped/staked receipts and tokenized assets listed separately), with live price and 24h change. Top 50 by default; Pro members can list up to 500.

tools.name: get_market_brief
tools.description: Current crypto market overview: RealCryptoCap AI 24h analysis (bias and key BTC levels), biggest movers among the top coins, and the latest headlines.

tools.name: get_crypto_news
tools.description: Latest crypto market headlines with source, date and link.

tools.name: get_fear_greed
tools.description: Current crypto Fear & Greed index with recent history and classification (Extreme Fear to Extreme Greed). (RealCryptoCap Pro dataset.)

tools.name: get_derivatives
tools.description: Bitcoin and crypto derivatives pulse: funding rates, open interest and long/short ratios. (RealCryptoCap Pro dataset.)

tools.name: get_etf_flows
tools.description: Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF net flows, recent daily history and totals. (RealCryptoCap Pro dataset.)

tools.name: get_trading_signals
tools.description: RealCryptoCap market signals: RCI signal score, momentum and risk gauges for the crypto market. (RealCryptoCap Pro dataset.)

tools.name: get_global_liquidity
tools.description: Global liquidity index (central bank balance sheets / money supply) and its relationship to Bitcoin. (RealCryptoCap Pro dataset.)

tools.name: get_stablecoin_supply
tools.description: Total stablecoin supply and recent changes, a gauge of liquidity entering or leaving crypto. (RealCryptoCap Pro dataset.)

tools.name: get_real_vs_reported_market_cap
tools.description: RealCryptoCap real crypto market cap versus the headline reported market cap, with the excluded categories (stablecoins, wrapped/staked receipts, tokenized assets). (RealCryptoCap Pro dataset.)
